in_sanskrit.name: Arjith
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Resolute, Valiant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Arjith एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Arjith means resolute, valiant. This powerful name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is associated with the Hindu epic Mahabharata. Arjith was the name of one of the greatest warriors in Indian mythology, Arjuna, who was the charioteer of Lord Krishna and a central character in the Bhagavad Gita.
